title: INAUGURATION OF “NARI SHAKTI TAILORING CLASSES”
summary: On 25th October 2026, Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab (RCMSEP), in collaboration with Sarva Seva Sangh, inaugurated the Nari Shakti Tailoring Classes at Gautam Wadi, Gautam Nagar.
description:
On 25th October 2026, Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab (RCMSEP), in collaboration with Sarva Seva Sangh, inaugurated the Nari Shakti Tailoring Classes at Gautam Wadi, Gautam Nagar.
This skill development initiative aims to empower women from Gautam Nagar and neighbouring areas by providing training in stitching and tailoring, enabling them to acquire livelihood skills, become self-reliant and achieve financial independence.
The centre will also promote environmental sustainability by producing reusable cloth bags under the club's “Say No to Plastic” initiative, encouraging the community to adopt eco-friendly alternatives to plastic bags.
The inauguration was attended by 12 Rotarians, 2 Rotaractors and 5 representatives of Sarva Seva Sangh. The ribbon-cutting ceremony was conducted by President Rtn. Sunita Bedi, Rtn. Satinderpal Singh Ahluwalia, Rtn. Jotinder Singh Ahluwalia and Fr. Innocent of Sarva Seva Sangh. The classes will commence on 1st November 2026.
location: Gautam Nagar, Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
